// src/build/versionPins.ts
// pin-manifest: pins-rev-2026-07-r3
// generated-from: package-lock.json

export const VERSION_PINS: Record<string, string> = {
  "react": "18.3.1",
  "react-dom": "18.3.1",
  "typescript": "5.5.4",
  "eslint": "9.7.0",
  "prettier": "3.3.3",
  "vite": "5.3.5",
  "vitest": "2.0.5",
  "zod": "3.23.8",
  "axios": "1.7.2",
  "lodash": "4.17.21",
  "date-fns": "3.6.0",
  "@acme/img-resize": "6.2.9",
  "@acme/ui-kit": "4.1.0",
  "@acme/auth-client": "2.9.3",
  "@acme/logger": "1.4.2",
  "@acme/config-loader": "1.0.7",
  "@acme/feature-flags": "2.2.1",
  "@acme/cache-client": "3.0.5",
  "@acme/queue-client": "1.6.0",
  "@acme/db-client": "5.3.2",
  "webpack": "5.93.0",
  "babel-loader": "9.1.3",
  "postcss": "8.4.40",
  "tailwindcss": "3.4.7",
  "jest": "29.7.0",
  "ts-node": "10.9.2",
  "husky": "9.1.4",
  "commitlint": "19.3.0",
  "storybook": "8.2.6",
  "rollup": "4.19.1",
};

export function isPinned(pkg: string): boolean {
  return pkg in VERSION_PINS;
}
notes: A 30-entry semver pin registry where the query names the package directly (@acme/img-resize), so bm25's idf on the rare 'img'/'resize' tokens finds it comfortably inside the ~10% ceiling. Recency favors the registry's last few pins and misses the mid-file entry; frequency and llmlingua_style tie across most rows, since every package name and version string is locally unique, and land on earlier tied rows instead. The file path and pin-manifest id sit on their own header lines and are force-kept.
